name: bare-system-logger

exports.name: SystemLog
signatures:
interface SystemLog {
  readonly colors: boolean
  format(...data: unknown[]): string
  debug(...data: unknown[]): void
  info(...data: unknown[]): void
  warn(...data: unknown[]): void
  error(...data: unknown[]): void
  fatal(...data: unknown[]): void
  clear(): void
}
exports.description: A logger that writes formatted messages to the native OS system log, at `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`, and `fatal` severity levels.
